scope: Guardian technology, blueprint fragments, Guardian Technology Broker unlocks, Guardian-site farming, Guardian modules and weapons, Guardian SLFs, modified Guardian weapons, and Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance used by the Mongrels Field Manual and Ask the Mongrels.

entries.topic: Guardian Technology: What to Unlock First
entries.ruleOfThumb: For most CMDRs, unlock the Guardian FSD Booster first. After that, prioritize Guardian Module Reinforcement / Shield Reinforcement for specific builds and Guardian weapons if AX combat is part of the plan.
details: Guardian technology is obtained by collecting blueprint fragments and Guardian materials, then using Guardian Technology Brokers or special broker routes.
The FSD Booster has broad value outside combat because it adds flat jump range in an optional internal slot.
Guardian weapons matter primarily for Anti-Xeno combat, while Guardian reinforcement modules are build-dependent.
Do not farm every Guardian blueprint blindly; decide which modules or weapons the build actually needs first.

sources.name: INARA — Guardian FSD Booster / Guardian modules outfitting

entries.ruleOfThumb: Guardian blueprint fragments are not interchangeable: Module fragments unlock Guardian modules, Weapon fragments unlock Guardian weapons, and Vessel fragments unlock Guardian ship-launched fighters.
details: Guardian Module Blueprint Fragments are used by six Guardian module unlocks including the FSD Booster, hull/module/shield reinforcements, power plant and power distributor.
Guardian Weapon Blueprint Fragments are used for Gauss Cannon, Plasma Charger and Shard Cannon variants, including modified broker purchases.
Guardian Vessel Blueprint Fragments are used for the three Guardian ship-launched fighters.
All three fragment families are obtained from Ancient/Guardian ruins or structures, but different structure types and activation routes produce different blueprint categories.

entries.ruleOfThumb: At a Guardian structure, use the Scarab SRV: wake and charge the six pylons, provide the required relic/key to the Ancient Data Terminal, then scan the activated terminal with the Data Link Scanner for the blueprint fragment.
details: Small module/weapon Guardian structures commonly use six Power Pylons and one Ancient Data Terminal.
Ancient Relics are obtained by shooting the glowing crystal from relic towers and are used to activate normal module/weapon terminals after the pylons are charged.
Scan Ancient Obelisks for Pattern Alpha/Beta/Gamma/Delta/Epsilon data while at the site.
Shoot destructible panels for Guardian Power Cells, Power Conduits and Technology Components; Guardian Sentinels can drop Wreckage Components and Sentinel Weapon Parts.
Use SRV synthesis for ammunition, fuel and repairs during repeated farming runs.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Farm the whole Guardian site while you are there: destructible panels supply physical Guardian components, obelisks supply Pattern data, and Sentinels supply wreckage/weapon parts.
details: Guardian Technology Components are especially common requirements across Guardian weapon and module broker recipes.
Pattern Obelisk Data is Encoded Guardian material and different unlocks require different pattern grades.
Guardian Sentinel Weapon Parts and Wreckage Components come from site combat and are needed by several Guardian unlocks.
A targeted material shopping list prevents repeated long-distance trips back to Guardian space.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Treat normal Guardian modules and standard Guardian weapons as broker unlocks: pay the listed blueprint/material requirement for the unlock, then obtain the unlocked module through outfitting where available.
details: Guardian Technology Brokers list the required blueprint fragment plus Guardian and human materials for each unlock.
One module-family unlock can expose multiple sizes of that module, such as the Guardian FSD Booster family.
Standard Guardian weapon variants are separate unlock entries by size/mount type; check the broker list before deciding how many Weapon Blueprint Fragments to farm.
Modified Guardian weapons are a different acquisition path and should not be assumed to behave like these reusable standard unlocks.

entries.ruleOfThumb: The Guardian FSD Booster is usually the highest-value first Guardian unlock. The 5H version adds 10.5 ly of flat jump range but consumes a Class 5 optional internal slot.
details: The FSD Booster is an optional internal module; it does not replace the ship's Frame Shift Drive.
Its bonus stacks with normal FSD engineering and other jump-range optimization.
The largest common 5H booster adds 10.5 ly; smaller classes trade slot size for a smaller flat bonus.
Because the benefit is flat rather than percentage-based, it is useful on explorers, cargo ships and combat ships that can spare the optional slot.

sources.name: INARA — Guardian FSD Booster Technology Broker recipe

entries.ruleOfThumb: The six core Guardian module unlock families are FSD Booster, Hull Reinforcement, Module Reinforcement, Shield Reinforcement, Hybrid Power Distributor and Power Plant.
details: Guardian Module Reinforcement is a common AX consideration when strong module protection is needed.
Guardian Shield Reinforcement adds raw shield strength through an optional internal module and can be useful on shield-focused builds.
Guardian Hybrid Power Plant and Power Distributor provide ready-made Guardian hybrid performance but compete with fully engineered human modules on specialized builds.
Guardian Hull Reinforcement is build-specific; compare thermal/power behavior and resistances against engineered human HRPs before committing slots.

entries.topic: Gauss Cannon, Shard Cannon & Plasma Charger
entries.ruleOfThumb: Guardian Gauss is the precision AX staple; Shards favor close-range burst; Plasma Chargers favor charged projectile play. Match the weapon to the AX role and your heat/range-control skill.
details: Standard Guardian weapons are primarily AX tools and use Guardian Weapon Blueprint Fragments for broker unlocks.
Gauss Cannons reward precision and are widely used for Interceptor heart work.
Shard Cannons deliver strong close-range burst but demand tighter range control.
Plasma Chargers use charge mechanics and offer a different projectile profile from Gauss or Shards.
Weapon heat, convergence, ammunition and the specific Interceptor/build matter more than a single universal ranking.

entries.topic: Modified Guardian Weapons: Per-Copy Broker Purchases
entries.ruleOfThumb: Modified Guardian Gauss, Shard and Plasma variants are not the same as standard reusable Guardian weapon unlocks: each copy requires its listed broker materials, including another Guardian Weapon Blueprint Fragment.
details: INARA lists separate Modified Guardian Gauss, Shard and Plasma Charger broker recipes.
Current community guidance confirms that these are acquired one module at a time: materials in, one modified weapon out.
Modified Shards and Plasma Chargers can be very strong in the right AX build, but their handling/heat differs from standard versions.
Broker location/access requirements for special Azimuth equipment can be faction/permit dependent, so verify the current location before traveling.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Ram Tah can apply Grade 1 Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance to supported Guardian equipment, giving +100% resistance to Thargoid anti-Guardian fields.
details: The modification is specifically designed to stop supported Guardian equipment from being disabled/damaged by Anti-Guardian fields.
INARA currently lists the Grade 1 recipe as 2 Hardened Surface Fragments and 1 Caustic Crystal per roll.
Ram Tah at Phoenix Base in Meene provides Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance engineering for Guardian weapon families and supported Guardian modules.
This modification matters when operating in environments where Thargoid Anti-Guardian fields are present; it is not necessary for ordinary space merely because a module is Guardian technology.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Guardian SLFs use Vessel Blueprint Fragments rather than Module or Weapon fragments. The three broker unlocks are the XG7 Trident, XG8 Javelin and XG9 Lance.
details: Each of the three Guardian fighter unlocks uses one Guardian Vessel Blueprint Fragment plus Guardian materials/data.
Vessel blueprint acquisition uses the Guardian vessel-site chain rather than the normal module/weapon terminal loop.
Guardian fighters still require a compatible Fighter Hangar and a pilot/crew workflow like other SLFs.
Unlock these only if the build or squad activity actually uses SLFs; they are not a prerequisite for Guardian modules or weapons.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Take a Scarab SRV, synthesis materials for SRV repair/rearm/refuel, and enough ship endurance to make repeated surface runs. A top-mounted Point Defence can help against Sentinel missiles near the ship.
details: The Guardian structure loop is designed around the SRV; on-foot traversal is unnecessary for normal blueprint farming.
Repeated runs can consume SRV ammunition and fuel, so bring the raw materials required for synthesis.
Collect blueprint fragments and supporting Guardian materials in the same trip whenever possible.
Before leaving the Bubble, make a Tech Broker shopping list so you know exactly how many Blueprint Fragments and Pattern-data types you need.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Choose the exact unlocks first, total their Blueprint Fragment/material requirements, farm the appropriate Guardian structure type, fill any human-material gaps, then visit the correct broker.
details: Module, Weapon and Vessel Blueprint Fragments come from different Guardian paths; farming the wrong fragment type wastes the trip.
Use the broker recipe itself as the shopping list rather than an old static guide because special weapon variants and requirements can change.
Farm extra Guardian Technology Components, Power Cells/Conduits, Obelisk Data and Sentinel drops while already on-site.
For AX builds, decide whether you need standard weapons, modified per-copy weapons, or Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance before calculating the final material requirement.
